deadline.value: December 1 applications due for full consideration
deadline.quote: Dec. 1 | Applications Due | For full consideration, all materials must be received. Apps received after Dec. 1 will be reviewed but may not receive full consideration due to space constraints.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are no longer required for admission.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are no longer required for admission. However, if you have taken the GRE, you may submit your scores and they will be included with your application.

gre_subject.value: ETS offers no Chemistry subject test.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Contact with a faculty member is not required for admission, but applicants are encouraged to contact prospective faculty.
supervisor.quote: Contact or support from a faculty member is not required for admission; the department reviews all applications. However, you are encouraged to contact any faculty member(s) if you are interested in their research and include their name as the department contact.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students receive stipend and benefits unless externally funded.
funding.quote: No. All students, with the exception of those who come with their own funding (e.g., government scholarships), receive a stipend and benefits.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from bachelor's degree with upper-division GPA of at least 3.0.
entry_route.quote: For applicants with solely a bachelor’s degree, a minimum 3.0 GPA on all coursework completed after the applicant has earned 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) is required.
